BiblicalUsage: Na'ah is a home, a dwelling place, and by extension the pastures where shepherds keep their flocks. In Amos 1:2 the habitations of the shepherds mourn when the Lord roars from Zion, and in Jeremiah 9:10 the habitations of the wilderness are burned up so that no one passes through them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a word as plain as home can carry judgment when the people who live there have turned away; God notices the places where ordinary life goes on, and when He speaks, the pastures hear it first.
